beats: My app generated fine vocabulary lessons, but the grammar drills were just random irregular verbs.
No connection to the textbook I studied from, and no one checking if the Norwegian was correct.
Drills now follow that same textbook's syllabus, and Claude proofreads every one first.
Blocks are reused instead of rewritten each time, one fix and it stays fixed.
Verb drills now scale all the way up through B2 and C1 level.
